articles.title: After US$474m gamble flops, what happens now to Elon Musk’s Tesla, SpaceX and China ties?
articles.summary: Elon Musk bet nearly half a billion dollars that political spending could keep Washington friendly to his sprawling business empire. On Tuesday, that bet came up short. As Democrats recaptured control of the US Congress in the midterm elections, the world’s richest man found himself facing an abruptly altered political landscape. articles.title: OpenAI to Change How It Handles Data Centers After Outcry
articles.summary: OpenAI said it will avoid nondisclosure agreements when it negotiates data center deals and ensure residents don’t pay for the electricity to power those projects, part of a framework the company believes should be adopted into laws governing the expansion of artificial intelligence.

articles.title: China blocks SoftBank’s US$5.4 billion takeover of ABB’s robotics division
articles.summary: China’s state planner has told Japanese investor SoftBank it will not allow the US$5.4 billion acquisition ‌of the robotics segment of engineering group ABB to go ahead, the Swiss firm said on Thursday. The case marks the second major deal blocked by China this year after Meta Platforms was ordered to unwind its US$2 billion-plus acquisition of artificial intelligence start-up Manus. articles.title: T-Mobile Customers Swap Roaming, Hotspots For Streaming Benefits
articles.summary: T-Mobile US Inc. customers are being given the chance to add free phone plan benefits like Apple TV streaming subscriptions and Xbox Game Pass access, instead of more traditional benefits like international roaming.
